title: Softmax (and temperature): math, numpy, and pytorch

cues.en: Softmax is among the most important transformations in deep learning.
cues.zh: Softmax 是深度學習最重要的轉換之一。

cues.en: So I'm going to spend several lectures talking about the meaning and nuances of the softmax function.
cues.zh: 所以，會花幾講，談它的意義與細節。

cues.en: In particular, in this video I'm going to focus on temperature and logsoftmax.
cues.zh: 這支影片，特別專注溫度與 log_softmax。

cues.en: Now, if you've gone through the appendix section at the end of the course, then you might have also watched the intro to softmax video and that corresponding code file.
cues.zh: 如果看過課程末尾附錄，可能也看過 softmax 入門影片與對應程式。

cues.en: Now, the lecture that you are watching right now is a bit of a review of that lecture, but it's not
cues.zh: 這一講，有一部分複習，但不是

cues.en: fully redundant because I'll talk about some issues here that I did not bring up in this video.
cues.zh: 完全重複，因為會談一些那支影片沒提到的問題。

cues.en: And then there's going to be even more videos covering other important nuances to know about the softmax function later in this section and also in the next section.
cues.zh: 這一章稍後，以及下一章，還會有更多影片，介紹其他重要細節。

cues.en: Softmax is just one of those things that seems simple at first, but turns out to be surprisingly rich once you get into it.
cues.zh: Softmax 看似簡單，深入後，卻出乎意料地豐富。

cues.en: Quick reminder softmax is based on the natural exponent, which is e to the x, where e is this irrational
cues.zh: 快速提醒，它以自然指數 e 的 x 次方為基礎，e 是這個無理

cues.en: number.
cues.zh: 數，

cues.en: It's 2.718, and it goes on and on.
cues.zh: 2.718，後面還有無窮位數。

cues.en: There are two features of the natural exponential that are relevant for softmax.
cues.zh: 自然指數有兩個與 softmax 相關的特性。

cues.en: One is that it's a strictly positive function, meaning that it's not possible for E to the x to be a negative number.
cues.zh: 一，嚴格為正，e 的 x 次方不可能為負。

cues.en: As x goes down to minus infinity, e to the x goes towards zero, but it can never equal exactly zero, and it can never be negative.
cues.zh: x 趨近負無窮時，e 的 x 次方趨近 0，但永不精確等於 0，也不會為負。

cues.en: The other important feature of E to the x is that it bends upwards nonlinearly.
cues.zh: 另一個，是非線性向上彎曲，

cues.en: So as x gets larger, e to the X gets really, really large.
cues.zh: x 越大，e 的 x 次方就變得非常大。

cues.en: Now this becomes relevant because relatively large values are going to get really, really large when you push them through a softmax function.
cues.zh: 因此，相對大的值，經 softmax 後，會非常突出。

cues.en: And that is useful because it helps the model pick out a very small number of tokens out of a very large vocabulary.
cues.zh: 有助模型從龐大詞彙表，挑出極少數 token。

cues.en: So here you see the softmax function.
cues.zh: 這是 softmax 函式，

cues.en: It's a very simple equation very simple transformation.
cues.zh: 非常簡單的式子與轉換。

cues.en: So if you have some set of numbers in z data set z variable z, then sigma I is e to the z I.
cues.zh: 有一組數字 z，資料集或變數 z，sigma_i 是 e 的 z_i 次方，

cues.en: So the ith number in z divided by the sum over all of the e to the Zs.
cues.zh: 也就是 z 中第 i 個值的指數，除以所有 z 值指數的總和。

cues.en: Now, as a bit of an aside, this Greek letter sigma is variously used for softmax, standard deviation,
cues.zh: 順帶一提，希臘字母 sigma，有時用於 softmax、標準差，

cues.en: and also as a general indicator of a non-linear nonlinear activation function and other quantities as well.
cues.zh: 也作為非線性活化函式，或其他量的一般符號。

cues.en: There are just more things that we need to do and represent in math than we have letters of all the alphabets.
cues.zh: 數學要表示的東西，比所有字母表的字母還多，

cues.en: So we end up with some redundancy.
cues.zh: 所以，有些重複。

cues.en: It's a little confusing, but that's just how it is.
cues.zh: 有點混淆，但就是如此。

cues.en: Anyway, it turns out that when you softmax a bunch of numbers, those numbers after the softmax transformation are guaranteed to be a probability distribution.
cues.zh: 對一組數字做 softmax，轉換後保證構成機率分布。

cues.en: Now, why is that the case?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: And what even is a probability distribution?
cues.zh: 又什麼是機率分布？

cues.en: A probability function is a function that maps events onto probabilities.
cues.zh: 機率函數，把事件映射到機率。

cues.en: They can be continuous observations like height or income, or they can be discrete events like movie genre or letters of the alphabet.
cues.zh: 可以是身高、收入這類連續觀察，或電影類型、字母這類離散事件。

cues.en: As long as the function is mapping events onto the probabilities of those events happening or being observed, then it is a probability function.
cues.zh: 只要把事件，映射到發生或被觀察到的機率，就是機率函數。

cues.en: There are two conditions for a function to be formally considered a probability function.
cues.zh: 形式上，有兩個條件，

cues.en: Those are shown here in math notation.
cues.zh: 用數學記號寫在這裡。

cues.en: So this first one here means that all of the probability values, all the function values must be greater than or equal to zero.
cues.zh: 第一，所有機率，也就是函數值，必須大於等於 0。

cues.en: It is not possible to have a negative probability.
cues.zh: 不可能有負機率。

cues.en: This is sometimes called the Non-negativity condition.
cues.zh: 有時叫非負條件。

cues.en: Next we have the condition that all of the probability values must sum to one.
cues.zh: 第二，所有機率值，必須加總為 1。

cues.en: So you take all the probabilities for all the events in the function.
cues.zh: 取函數中所有事件的機率，

cues.en: Add them all up and you have to get the number one.
cues.zh: 全部加起來，必須得到 1。

cues.en: Now this integral here is for when the function is describing continuous events.
cues.zh: 這裡積分，是用於連續事件。

cues.en: And if you have discrete events like tokens then it's the same concept.
cues.zh: 離散事件，例如 token，概念相同，

cues.en: But you would use a summation instead of an integral.
cues.zh: 只是用加總，而不是積分。

cues.en: Now this condition here is sometimes called the normalization condition.
cues.zh: 這個條件，有時叫正規化條件。

cues.en: So how do we know that the softmax transformation actually satisfies these two conditions.
cues.zh: 怎麼知道 softmax 符合兩個條件？

cues.en: Well it's literally baked right into the formula itself E to the anything cannot possibly be negative.
cues.zh: 公式本身就保證：e 的任何次方，都不可能為負。

cues.en: So that alone satisfies the non-negativity condition.
cues.zh: 這就符合非負條件。

cues.en: We see that the denominator is a sum over all the values in our data set.
cues.zh: 分母，是資料集中所有指數值的總和。

cues.en: And so if we sum up all of these sigma values for all the numerators, then we would end up with the
cues.zh: 如果加總所有 sigma，也就是各分子，

cues.en: exact same sum in the numerator as in the denominator, which means that the sum over all the values is by definition one, and that is the normalization condition.
cues.zh: 分子就會和分母有相同的總和，因此結果必然為 1，符合正規化條件。

cues.en: So basically, when you softmax a collection of numbers that are not by themselves a probability function.
cues.zh: 所以，一組數字，本來不是機率函數，

cues.en: The softmax transformation actually makes them into a probability function.
cues.zh: softmax 就把它們轉成機率函數。

cues.en: The A here stands for arbitrary units, meaning as long as the inputs are numeric, it doesn't actually matter what the numbers are.
cues.zh: 這裡 a.u. 代表任意單位，只要輸入為數值，實際數字是什麼，不重要。

cues.en: They can be greater than one.
cues.zh: 可以大於 1，

cues.en: They can be negative.
cues.zh: 可以為負，

cues.en: That doesn't matter.
cues.zh: 都沒關係。

cues.en: The output of the softmax transformation will be a probability distribution.
cues.zh: 輸出會是機率分布。

cues.en: That is pretty neat.
cues.zh: 很棒，

cues.en: And it has a lot of implications and applications in machine learning optimization.
cues.zh: 在機器學習最佳化，有許多影響與應用。

cues.en: And for our purposes here also text generation by language models.
cues.zh: 對我們，也用於語言模型的文字生成。

cues.en: So this is the softmax function.
cues.zh: 這又是 softmax，

cues.en: Yet again you've seen this a hundred times now.
cues.zh: 現在應該看過一百次了。

cues.en: And now we can add a parameter here I'm calling t.
cues.zh: 可以加入一個參數，這裡叫 T，

cues.en: Sometimes it's also called beta or one minus beta.
cues.zh: 有時也叫 beta，或 1 減 beta。

cues.en: And it is called the temperature parameter or sometimes the softness of the soft max.
cues.zh: 稱為溫度參數，有時也叫 softmax 的柔和程度。

cues.en: By the way, a little bit about notation.
cues.zh: 記號方面，

cues.en: When the exponent of a natural exponential starts to get long and complicated, people will often just use the letters exp and then parentheses.
cues.zh: 自然指數的指數部分太長、太複雜時，常寫成 exp 加圓括號。

cues.en: So what's inside the parentheses is in the superscript in the power of the exponential.
cues.zh: 括號裡，就是原先上標的指數。

cues.en: Anyway, you can see that when t equals one, then we have the same original formula that you're.
cues.zh: T 等於 1，就回到你一直看到的

cues.en: You've seen so far.
cues.zh: 原始公式。

cues.en: So what is this parameter for and what does it do.
cues.zh: 參數有什麼用？做什麼？

cues.en: Well the idea is to set T to be some number typically larger than one let's say 1.5 or 2.
cues.zh: 構想是，把 T 設成通常大於 1 的數，例如 1.5 或 2。

cues.en: Now that obviously just shrinks down all the numbers by a little bit.
cues.zh: 顯然，會把所有數字稍微縮小，

cues.en: But the impact is at the probability distribution becomes flatter.
cues.zh: 影響是機率分布更平坦。

cues.en: In other words, the larger numbers pop out less the higher the temperature is set.
cues.zh: 換句話說，溫度越高，較大數字就越不突出。

cues.en: And why does that happen?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Well, if we look back at the graph of each of the x, then the higher the the number x, the faster each of the x climbs up to really large numbers.
cues.zh: 回看 e 的 x 次方圖，x 越高，函式越快增長到大值。

cues.en: So if we just compress all of the numbers so that they are closer to zero by dividing by some factor
cues.zh: 所以，除以大於 1 的因子，把數值

cues.en: greater than one, then the whole distribution just becomes a little more numerically similar.
cues.zh: 壓到更靠近 0，整個分布的數值就更相近。

cues.en: For example, imagine we have a data point with a value of two that goes into the softmax function.
cues.zh: 例如，值為 2 的資料點，輸入 softmax。

cues.en: Its softmax output is whatever this is.
cues.zh: 它的輸出，就是這個，

cues.en: Maybe it's around seven.
cues.zh: 可能大約 7。

cues.en: Then imagine what would happen if we set the temperature to two.
cues.zh: 再想，溫度設為 2，會怎樣？

cues.en: Now in terms of x that's only gone down by a factor of one half.
cues.zh: x 只變成一半，

cues.en: In this case just one unit.
cues.zh: 這裡只減少一個單位，

cues.en: But the output of the softmax function that value actually decreased Exponentially.
cues.zh: 但輸出值，卻以指數方式減少。

cues.en: You will see more of this in the Python demos in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後 Python 示範，會看更多。

cues.en: One more concept I'm going to introduce here is Logsoftmax.
cues.zh: 還要介紹 log_softmax。

cues.en: This transformation is super duper simple.
cues.zh: 轉換非常簡單，

cues.en: You just calculate the softmax exactly as you already did, but now you take as logarithm typically the natural log.
cues.zh: 先照剛才算 softmax，再取對數，通常自然對數，

cues.en: Although I'm just writing out the word log here.
cues.zh: 這裡只寫 log。

cues.en: So the impact of taking a log is to stretch out the very small numbers, which helps the optimization
cues.zh: 對數，把非常小的數字拉開，幫助最佳化

cues.en: model distinguish between very small probabilities, which in turn improves the optimization, especially
cues.zh: 模型區分極小的機率，進而改善最佳化，尤其

cues.en: when you have a really large number of categories where most probabilities are close to zero.
cues.zh: 類別很多，大多數機率接近 0 時。

cues.en: So that is when the model is trying to predict the next token based on previous tokens.
cues.zh: 這正是根據先前 token，預測下一個的情況。

cues.en: Most of the 100,000 tokens in the vocab are going to have a low probability of being selected, and
cues.zh: 詞彙表十萬個 token，大多數被選中的機率很低，

cues.en: that means that most of the tokens will have a softmax number that is very, very close to zero.
cues.zh: 所以，大多數 softmax 值，極接近 0。

cues.en: So applying the log transform helps to stretch out those tiny numbers.
cues.zh: 取對數，有助拉開這些極小數值，

cues.en: And that improves numerical stability and also helps the model continue suppressing and learning from the probability of irrelevant tokens.
cues.zh: 改善數值穩定，也幫模型繼續壓低、學習無關 token 的機率。

cues.en: Now this is one of these situations where we have to take some extra precautions and tricks, because these language models are so incredibly huge.
cues.zh: 因為語言模型極大，所以需要額外的預防措施與技巧。

cues.en: That is to say, you don't really need logsoftmax for relatively simple problems or simple models.
cues.zh: 相對簡單的問題、模型，不一定需要 log_softmax。

cues.en: But as the number of categories increases, then logsoftmax becomes really critical.
cues.zh: 但類別數增加，log_softmax 就非常關鍵。

cues.en: Of course, in language models, the number of categories is the number of tokens.
cues.zh: 語言模型的類別數，當然是 token 數，

cues.en: And that's really large.
cues.zh: 非常大，

cues.en: That can be up to a few hundred thousand.
cues.zh: 可能有數十萬。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: In a moment I will switch to Python to go through some demos.
cues.zh: 稍後切換到 Python 示範。

cues.en: Now, some of the code in the beginning of this demo is very similar to code from the appendix section, but I'll go through that stuff fairly briskly.
cues.zh: 開頭有些程式，和附錄相似，會快速帶過。

cues.en: I'll spend more time talking about the impact of the temperature parameter, and how that affects the
cues.zh: 多花時間談溫度參數的影響，以及它如何改變

cues.en: probability distribution and implications that has for selecting the next token during text generation.
cues.zh: 機率分布，進而影響生成時選下一 token。

cues.en: And I will also highlight the difference between the regular softmax and logsoftmax.
cues.zh: 也會強調，一般 softmax 與 log_softmax 的差別。

cues.en: Here I'm importing the libraries that we will need.
cues.zh: 匯入需要的函式庫。

cues.en: And here is just a quick intro to softmax in numpy.
cues.zh: 先快速介紹 NumPy softmax。

cues.en: So here I have a small data set just the numbers one two, three.
cues.zh: 有個小資料集，就是 1、2、3。

cues.en: Here is the numerator for all of the softmax results.
cues.zh: 這是各 softmax 結果的分子，

cues.en: So it's just e to the z e to these numbers.
cues.zh: 也就是 z 的指數，這些數字的指數。

cues.en: And the denominator is also e to the numbers.
cues.zh: 分母，同樣先取指數，

cues.en: And then we sum over all of those numbers.
cues.zh: 再加總，

cues.en: And then we get the numerator divided by the denominator.
cues.zh: 最後分子除以分母。

cues.en: And here are those transformed numbers.
cues.zh: 這就是轉換後的數字，

cues.en: And they all sum to one.
cues.zh: 全部加總為 1。

cues.en: Now already from this small data set you can see the nonlinear transformation.
cues.zh: 這個小資料集，已能看出非線性。

cues.en: So for example two is two times one right.
cues.zh: 例如，2 是 1 的兩倍，

cues.en: So one times two is two.
cues.zh: 1 乘以 2，就是 2。

cues.en: But when we look at the softmax transformation twice nine is 18.
cues.zh: 但 softmax 後，0.09 的兩倍是 0.18，

cues.en: And the softmax version of two is more than twice as large as the softmax version of one.
cues.zh: 2 的 softmax 值，卻超過 1 的兩倍。

cues.en: Same thing here three is 1.5 times two, but 0.66 is more than twice of 0.24.
And as this number increases, this becomes even more extreme.
cues.zh: 數字越大，越極端。

cues.en: So if we set this to be eight now, eight is only four times bigger than two.
cues.zh: 改成 8，雖然只是 2 的四倍，

cues.en: But the softmax version is actually two orders of magnitude, so it's 100 times bigger than two.
cues.zh: softmax 值卻大兩個數量級，也就是約 100 倍。

cues.en: Now I will repeat with some random integers.
cues.zh: 再用隨機整數。

cues.en: So here I'm just generating some random numbers between -5 and 15.
cues.zh: 產生負 5 到 15 之間的隨機數，

cues.en: So these correspond to or there's 25 of them.
cues.zh: 總共 25 個。

cues.en: So imagine that these would be the outputs, the raw numerical outputs from a language model.
cues.zh: 想像是語言模型的原始數值輸出，

cues.en: And the 25 corresponds to 25 tokens.
cues.zh: 25 個值，對應 25 個 token。

cues.en: Now the largest number here is you know what is it 14 okay.
cues.zh: 最大值是多少？14。

cues.en: 14 is technically larger than 13, but it's not that much bigger than 13, relatively speaking, to this distribution.
cues.zh: 14 比 13 大，但相對整個分布，沒大那麼多。

cues.en: But when we softmax, then we see that the largest value, which is 14, really pops out from the rest of the distribution.
cues.zh: softmax 後，最大值 14，卻明顯突出。

cues.en: So basically, if a language model is probabilistically selecting a token based on these numbers, it's
cues.zh: 如果語言模型直接依這些數字抽樣，

cues.en: not that much more likely to pick a token with the logit of 14 compared to a logit of 13.
cues.zh: logit 為 14 的 token，不會比 13 高出太多。

cues.en: But after softmax, we see that the token with the logit of 14 is just much, much higher than the one with the 13.
cues.zh: 但 softmax 後，14 對應的機率，比 13 高得多。

cues.en: So basically the large numbers really pop out of the distribution.
cues.zh: 大值，明顯突出於分布。

cues.en: That's what softmax does.
cues.zh: 這就是 softmax 的作用。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Here I want to show you something quickly in PyTorch.
cues.zh: 快速展示 PyTorch。

cues.en: So the PyTorch function for softmax is softmax.
cues.zh: softmax 的 PyTorch 函式，就叫 softmax。

cues.en: And we can put in a PyTorch tensor.
cues.zh: 輸入 PyTorch 張量，

cues.en: So this is the numbers that I showed here.
cues.zh: 就是這裡的數字，

cues.en: I'm just converting them into a tensor.
cues.zh: 只是轉成張量。

cues.en: Now when I run this cell I get a bunch of numbers.
cues.zh: 執行區塊，得到一堆數字，

cues.en: These actually correspond to exactly these numbers over here.
cues.zh: 和這裡完全相同。

cues.en: But we also get a warning message.
cues.zh: 但也收到警告，

cues.en: And this warning message says implicit dimension choice has been depreciated.
cues.zh: 說隱式選擇維度，已棄用。

cues.en: Basically, PyTorch no longer wants to make assumptions about the dimension along which you want to calculate softmax.
cues.zh: 基本上，PyTorch 不再想替你假設，沿哪個維度算 softmax。

cues.en: Now, that's a weird warning message for this particular case, because this variable here, you know,
cues.zh: 這個例子，警告有點奇怪，因為

cues.en: there's only one possible dimension along which to softmax is just a vector.
cues.zh: 只是向量，只有一個可能維度。

cues.en: But, you know, for a multi-dimensional tensors this can be a source of confusion.
cues.zh: 但多維張量中，確實容易混淆。

cues.en: Now in this case we can right axis equal or sorry dim dom dim equals zero.
cues.zh: 這裡可以寫 axis，抱歉，是 dim=0。

cues.en: And now we get exactly the same numbers but no warning messages.
cues.zh: 數字相同，但沒有警告。

cues.en: It will often happen not all the time in PyTorch, but very often in large language models that we want
cues.zh: PyTorch 不一定總是如此，但在大型語言模型中，經常

cues.en: to softmax along the last dimension.
cues.zh: 要沿最後一維做 softmax。

cues.en: And that's because the last dimension, the final dimension in many of the tensors that we will work with correspond to tokens and the token logits.
cues.zh: 因為很多張量的最後一維，對應 token 與 token logits。

cues.en: So you will often see code that looks like this softmax.
cues.zh: 所以，常看到這樣的程式：softmax，

cues.en: And then, you know some logits.
cues.zh: 輸入某組 logits，

cues.en: This will be the output of the model.
cues.zh: 也就是模型輸出，

cues.en: And then dim equals minus one.
cues.zh: 再設 dim=-1。

cues.en: Not always.
cues.zh: 不是永遠如此。

cues.en: But anyway the point is that you need to input this second optional argument.
cues.zh: 總之，重點是，要輸入第二個參數。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now I would like to discuss temperature.
cues.zh: 接著，溫度。

cues.en: So what I'm doing here is taking these values here.
cues.zh: 取這些值，

cues.en: These ones over here.
cues.zh: 就是這裡，

cues.en: So linearly spaced numbers minus five to plus 15.
cues.zh: 負 5 到正 15 的等距數字。

cues.en: These are obviously not probability values.
cues.zh: 顯然不是機率，

cues.en: They're negative and they're greater than one.
cues.zh: 有負值，也有大於 1，

cues.en: They will certainly sum to a number other than one.
cues.zh: 加總肯定不是 1。

cues.en: But these are the raw scores.
cues.zh: 這些是原始分數。

cues.en: And then I'm going to softmax them and also logsoftmax them.
cues.zh: 接著，對它們做 softmax 與 log_softmax，

cues.en: So exactly the same numbers uh softmax and logsoftmax after dividing by this temperature parameter here.
cues.zh: 同樣數字，先除以這個溫度參數。

cues.en: So the first one is like standard classic softmax, old school softmax, and then using higher and higher
cues.zh: 第一個，是標準、傳統 softmax，再用越來越高的

cues.en: temperatures that we will see what is the impact of that temperature scaling.
cues.zh: 溫度，看看縮放有什麼影響。

cues.en: By the way, it might seem weird that there's this whole separate function just for log softmax, because why don't we just write it like this torch dot log.
cues.zh: 可能覺得奇怪，為什麼 log_softmax 還要獨立函式，不直接寫 torch.log？

cues.en: The reason is that, uh, for well-behaved numbers, you can actually just implement everything on your own.
cues.zh: 如果數字很正常，確實可以全部自己實作，

cues.en: You can implement the softmax function on your own, as I showed at the beginning of this code demo.
cues.zh: 也能像示範開頭，自己實作 softmax。

cues.en: As you get to larger and larger data sets with values that are closer and closer to zero, you start
cues.zh: 但資料集越大，數值越接近 0，

cues.en: to run into numerical inaccuracy problems, rounding errors, all sorts of precision errors that plague computers.
cues.zh: 會遇到數值不準確、四捨五入，以及各種電腦精度問題。

cues.en: So therefore, PyTorch has a dedicated implementation for softmax and logsoftmax that is more robust
cues.zh: 因此，PyTorch 有專用 softmax 與 log_softmax 實作，更能抵抗

cues.en: to numerical inaccuracies and numerical issues.
cues.zh: 數值誤差與問題。

cues.en: I have a whole video about that later on in this section, but I just wanted to mention it now.
cues.zh: 這一章稍後，有一整支談，但先提一下。

cues.zh: 看結果。

cues.en: So here we see the blue line.
cues.zh: 這是藍線，

cues.en: Here is temperature equals one.
cues.zh: 溫度等於 1，

cues.en: So this is like the normal vanilla softmax with no temperature parameter defined.
cues.zh: 就是沒有定義溫度參數的一般 softmax，

cues.en: So that means it's implicitly set to one.
cues.zh: 隱含為 1。

cues.en: And here we have higher values of temperature.
cues.zh: 這裡，是更高的溫度。

cues.en: Now what does this mean.
cues.zh: 代表什麼？

cues.en: Again let's imagine that each of these numbers corresponds to 35 tokens that we have in our vocabulary.
cues.zh: 再次想像，詞彙表有 35 個 token，各對應這些數字。

cues.en: And these values here these raw scores would be the logits for each individual token after the model has finished processing those tokens.
cues.zh: 原始分數，就是模型處理後，各 token 的 logits。

cues.en: Now, what these correspond to when they become softmax is the probability of being selected to be the next target.
cues.zh: softmax 後，對應被選為下一個目標的機率。

cues.en: Now in this case, when temperature is one, this the highest value really pops out from the rest of the distribution.
cues.zh: 溫度 1 時，最高值明顯突出。

cues.en: But as the temperature increases, the entire probability distribution becomes stabilized.
cues.zh: 溫度增加，整個分布變得穩定，

cues.en: It becomes flatter.
cues.zh: 更平坦。

cues.en: So here with the temperature equals ten, you know, this probability value is really close to its next it's neighboring probability value.
cues.zh: 例如溫度 10，這個機率，非常接近旁邊的機率。

cues.en: And the impact of that is that here the model is more likely to choose this one output this one token compared to the other ones.
cues.zh: 影響是，這裡模型比較可能選這個輸出、這個 token，而不是其他。

cues.en: And here when the temperature is higher, the model is going to probabilistically sample from, you know, these top several tokens.
cues.zh: 高溫度這裡，模型會從前面幾個 token 依機率抽樣，

cues.en: And it's kind of a little bit more likely to select this one.
cues.zh: 這個，還是稍微更可能，

cues.en: But it also might select these other tokens.
cues.zh: 但也可能選其他。

cues.en: I'm going to have a lot more to say about that in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一支影片，會談更多。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: But I hope that gives you some intuition.
cues.zh: 希望這有助建立直覺。

cues.en: So these are all values that equal or are greater than one.
cues.zh: 這些溫度，都大於等於 1。

cues.en: We can also, just out of curiosity, see what happens if we set the temperature to be less than one.
cues.zh: 也可以好奇地看看，小於 1 會怎樣，

cues.en: Perfectly valid parameter.
cues.zh: 完全是有效參數。

cues.en: There's no reason why these have to be greater than one.
cues.zh: 沒有理由一定大於 1。

cues.en: But now look what happens when we set the temperature to be 0.2.
cues.zh: 現在看，設成 0.2，

cues.en: So a number less than one that really, really intensifies the shape of the probability distribution.
cues.zh: 小於 1，會大幅強化機率分布形狀。

cues.en: So the entire distribution got pushed down towards zero.
cues.zh: 幾乎整個分布，都被壓到接近 0，

cues.en: And only the top numerical value got pushed all the way up to the top.
cues.zh: 只有最大值，被推到最上方。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: That is the impact of temperature.
cues.zh: 這就是溫度的影響。

cues.en: Over here we have exactly the same data but log transformed.
cues.zh: 這裡資料完全相同，只是取對數。

cues.en: So what you see here in the linear softmax.
cues.zh: 一般 softmax 這裡，

cues.en: Again this is not really a official term linear softmax I'm just using that here to differentiate it from logsoftmax.
cues.zh: 「線性 softmax」不是正式術語，只是為了區分 log_softmax 而使用。

cues.en: What you see here is that all of these numbers are kind of squished together.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這些數字全擠在一起，

cues.en: They all get compressed.
cues.zh: 被壓縮，

cues.en: They're all very small numbers, very close to zero.
cues.zh: 都是非常小、非常接近 0 的值。

cues.en: And then we take the logarithm.
cues.zh: 再取對數，

cues.en: And now all of those very small numbers are more stretched out.
cues.zh: 這些小數字，就更拉開，

cues.en: There's more spacing between the numbers.
cues.zh: 彼此間距更大。

cues.en: And that partly allows for increased numerical stability.
cues.zh: 一部分，有助數值穩定，

cues.en: It also helps the model learn to suppress these irrelevant tokens because they get pushed down really far.
cues.zh: 也幫助模型壓低無關 token，因為它們被推得非常低。

cues.en: The main thing I want to mention about temperature is that although it is useful for educational and
cues.zh: 關於溫度，主要想說，教學與

cues.zh: 概念理解上，可以想 5、10 或 0.1 這類極端值，但真正

cues.en: llms, it is more typical to use values that are closer to one, maybe 0.7, 1.1 or 1.2.
cues.zh: LLM 比較常用接近 1 的值，例如 0.7、1.1、1.2。

cues.en: So the real LM models generally stick to temperature values that are fairly close to one.
cues.zh: 所以，實際語言模型，通常用相當接近 1 的溫度。
